subject: Updated Site Layout and Parking Recommendation
overview: The advisory team voted to recommend a revised site plan for the Medford High School project that replaces a centralized parking lot with distributed spaces and improves pedestrian sightlines. The meeting also addressed the configuration of the new track and field stadium, a proposed building breezeway, and the placement of emergency call stations.

items.title: Parking Program
items.summary: The proposed parking plan provides 477 spaces to accommodate staff, visitors, and 100 students, with the flexibility to adjust counts if school programs are reduced.

items.title: Updated Site Layout Recommendation
items.summary: Recommended a revised site layout to the School Building Committee that rotates the rectangular field and distributes parking to create a more pedestrian-centric entrance experience. The motion passed.

items.title: Edgerly Track and Field
items.summary: The team detailed plans for a synthetic turf stadium with a six-lane oval track and support buildings, noting that the Department of Conservation and Recreation confirmed these structures are permissible on deed-restricted land.

items.title: Educational Program Breezeway
items.summary: A proposed second-level outdoor pass-through will provide a pedestrian shortcut and create separate, dedicated entrances for the Curtis Tufts and preschool programs.

items.title: Site Safety and Assistance Stations
items.summary: Designers identified strategic locations for emergency call for assistance towers with blue lights and potential AED cabinets in parking lots and near athletic fields.
